name: yAE-mIKO
description: A versatile Telegram Group Management Bot running on pure Kurigram MTProto runtime.

DEL_CMDS.description: Set this to True to delete command messages from users without the necessary permissions.

ENV.description: Set to a truthy value such as True or 1 to enable environment variables. Leave as is.

EVENT_LOGS.description: Channel for event logs. Records important bot-level events; make it public. Example: '-123456'

OWNER_ID.description: Your user ID as an integer.

DEV_USERS.description: Space-separated list of user IDs to assign as sudo users.

DRAGONS.description: Space-separated list of user IDs to assign as sudo users.

STRICT_GBAN.description: Enforce global bans in new and old groups. A gbanned user who talks is banned.

DEMONS.description: Space-separated list of user IDs allowed to run the global ban command.

TIGERS.description: Space-separated list of user IDs the bot cannot ban.

WOLVES.description: Space-separated list of user IDs to whitelist. The bot cannot ban them.

SUPPORT_CHAT.description: Your Telegram support group username. Users reach out there for help. Example: MyGroupChatUsernameBlah. Avoid pointing to Miko Support to prevent conflicts.

TOKEN.description: Bot token obtained from @BotFather on Telegram.

LOGGER.description: Unused. Log files are always written.
